ending:
Carrier line stopped. Recovery beacon transmitting. If another station calls, the union knows where to find me.
BRIDGE RESTORED · RESEARCH PRESERVED · SCRAP SCORE 0
The carrier line is stopped. The surviving banks establish a workable isolation procedure, with gaps marked wherever the research was lost. The union clears stations in stages and leaves the uncertain sections sealed.

Echo keeps new rescue calls under independent verification until the missing relay records can be recovered.

Flint builds the clean repair effort around your recovered equipment records. The remaining blocked service routes will need another crew.

Your surviving manifests enter the union inquiry. The original Dock Nine approvals still need to be recovered.

Rook files the last report as salvage and recovery. The union keeps “specialist” beside his name. His suit still needs an overhaul. When the next station calls, he asks for its crew list before its cargo value.
title: CONTRACT CLOSED
